name: Fire Specialization
body:
Spell Level 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8 | 9

Arcane Specialization | Frost Specialization

An “F” or “M” appearing in the Comp. column denotes a focus or material component not normally included in a spell component pouch.

Order of Presentation: The spells (or formulae) are listed in alphabetical order by name, except when a spell’s name begins with “lesser,” “greater,” or “mass,” in which case it is alphabetized under the second word of the spell name.

Hit Dice: The term “Hit Dice” is used synonymously with “character levels” for effects that affect a specific number of Hit Dice of creatures.

Caster Level: A spell’s power often depends on caster level, which is defined as the caster’s class level for the purpose of casting a particular spell. The word “level” in the short spell descriptions that follow always refers to caster level.

Creatures and Characters: “Creature” and “character” are used synonymously in the short descriptions.

1st-Level Fire Specialization Spells
Spell Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Burning Hands	 	1d4/level fire damage (max 5d4).	CRB
Produce Flame	 	1d6 damage + 1/level, touch or thrown.	CRB
Touch of Combustion	 	Touched target ignites in flame, suffering 1d6 fire damage and possibly catching on fire	ARG

2nd-Level Fire Specialization Spells
Spell Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Fire Breath	 	Exhale a cone of fire at will.	APG
Heat Metal	 	Makes metal so hot it damages those who touch it.	CRB
Scorching Ray	 	Ranged touch attack deals 4d6 fire damage, + 1 ray/four levels (max 3).	CRB
Spontaneous Immolation	 	Target takes 3d6 points of fire damage and catches on fire.	UC

3rd-Level Fire Specialization Spells
Spell Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Explosive Runes	 	Deals 6d6 damage when read.	CRB
Fire Trail	 	Trail of flame that follows your movements and deal 1d6+1 fire per CL (max +10).	ARG
Fireball	 	1d6 fire damage per level, 20-ft. radius.	CRB
Firestream	 	2d6 points of fire damage in a 20-ft. line, that can change each round.	ARG

4th-Level Fire Specialization Spells
Spell Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Controlled Fireball	 	As fireball, but secretly deals less damage to your allies.	UI
Detonate	 	Inflicts 1d8/level energy damage to all creatures within 15 ft.	APG
Flaming Sphere, Greater	 	Rolling ball of fire deals 6d6 fire damage and ignites targets.	ACG
Wall of Fire	 	Deals 2d4 fire damage out to 10 ft. and 1d4 out to 20 ft. Passing through wall deals 2d6 damage +1/level.	CRB

5th-Level Fire Specialization Spells
Spell Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Damnation Stride	 	Teleports you a short distance and produce a burst of fire.	ARG
Energy Siege Shot	 	A Large siege engine deals energy damage that you designate with other effects depending on the type of energy you choose.	UC
Fire Snake	 	Creates a serpentine path of fire 5 ft. long/level that deals 1d6 fire damage/level.	APG

6th-Level Fire Specialization Spells
Spell Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Chains of Fire	 	1d6/level fire damage and 1 secondary bolt/level.	ARG
Contagious Flame	 	Scorching rays cause 4d6 fire damage, then move on to new targets.	APG
Disintegrate	 	Reduces one creature or object to dust.	CRB

7th-Level Fire Specialization Spells
Spell Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Delayed Blast Fireball	 	1d6/level fire damage; you can postpone blast for up to 5 rounds.	CRB
Fire Storm	 	Deals 1d6/level fire damage.	CRB
Firebrand	 	Allies gain flaming weapons, immunity to your fire spells, and a one-use ray of fire attack.	APG

8th-Level Fire Specialization Spells
Spell Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Incendiary Cloud	 	Cloud deals 6d6 fire damage/round.	CRB
Sunburst	 	Blinds all within 10 ft., deals 6d6 damage.	CRB
Wall of Lava	 	Wall damages foes that try to enter, periodically launches lava at nearby targets.	APG

9th-Level Fire Specialization Spells
Spell Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Fiery Body	 	You gain various fire-related powers.	APG
Implosion	 	Inflict 10 damage/level to one creature/round.	CRB
Meteor Swarm	 	Four exploding spheres each deal 6d6 fire damage.	CRB
